summary: End-to-end validated (a) the merged /dashboard (no tab strip) and (b) the new Daily Learning Goal habit-engine card. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass for GET/PATCH /api/me/daily-goal covering default shape (target=15, week=7 items, preset_targets=[5,15,30,60]), persistence, Pydantic validation bounds (target<5 → 422, target>180 → 422), minutes computation (1 started + 1 completed = 2+8 = 10 today, pct=67), and 3-day streak logic via direct module_events seeding. Frontend Playwright: fresh user hits /dashboard, verified NO dashboard-tabs, self-service-portal + quick-links + daily-goal-card all render, ring shows '0/15 MIN TODAY', heatmap has 7 tiles with today highlighted, motivating copy 'The best time to build a learning habit is now…' renders, no streak chip for fresh user, preset picker opens with 4 buttons and current (15) is visually distinguished, click preset 30 → toast 'Daily goal set to 30 min' fires + picker closes + ring updates to '0/30 MIN TODAY', reload persists the 30. Also verified switching to 5-min target updates ring + adapts copy ('Just 5 minutes to your daily target. One lesson away.') without crashing. Personal details + Change password cards regression-verified below the goal card. Founding-member badge (Founding #105 for the fresh user), quick-links strip, referral panel, WhatsApp panel, next-best banner, enrollments empty-state, and recs strip all render on the unified page. Zero console errors (alerts-center 401 polls filtered as pre-existing).
critical_code_review_comments: me_router.py — _minutes_by_day + _streak_days are clean, deterministic, and correctly UTC-boundary aware. Yesterday-as-tail heuristic for streak is a nice UX touch.

DailyGoalCard.jsx — good separation of concerns: pure component, adapts copy through motivatingCopy(), no side-effects outside toast + api call. Ring uses CSS custom props (--ss-ring-value, --ss-ring-color) which is the idiomatic approach.

Minor: DailyGoalCard uses --ss-ring-value inline with `width: 140, height: 140` — CSS handles the SVG-less conic-gradient rendering; verified visually the ring renders correctly and center label is legible.
Minor: In the streak calc if a user has NO events in the last 8 days, per_day is {} and the while-loop breaks immediately — streak=0. Correct.

Minor: patch_daily_goal calls `get_daily_goal(user_id=user_id)` — this pattern is fine but slightly unusual (calling a FastAPI route function directly bypassing the DI system). Currently works because get_current_user_id is the only Depends. If more deps are added later this call pattern will silently break. Consider extracting shared logic to a helper.

Nit: HeatmapDay renders empty text for days with 0 minutes (correct); the tile with 0 min still passes the intensity=0 shade check. Considered whether missing-day render could suggest 'no data' vs '0 min' — current UX ('empty ghost tile') is reasonable.
No hardcoded URLs; frontend uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via api client. All data-testid attributes match the review spec exactly.
test_credentials: Fresh users registered via POST /api/auth/register with @example.com emails + TestPass123! password. Emails used this run: test_dg_<uuid>@example.com (pytest fixture, module-scoped) and test_ui_dg_<uuid>@example.com (Playwright).
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest seeded module_events directly via motor (with per-event unique module_id to respect the (user_id,course_id,module_id,kind) unique index). All events cleaned up after each test class.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Daily-goal feature + merged dashboard are stable. Backend endpoints: GET/PATCH /api/me/daily-goal fully contract-tested. UI regression: /dashboard is now single-scroll (no tabs). If future iterations reintroduce tabs, this test file (test_iteration66_daily_goal.py) will need re-verification. Note that module_events collection has a compound unique index on (user_id, course_id, module_id, kind) — when seeding events for streak tests you MUST vary module_id per event or you'll hit a duplicate-key error. Sonner toast selector `[data-sonner-toast]` works reliably for assertions.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Feature works as specified.
